content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define genetic engineering and describe the general process
Explain how genes are transferred between organisms
Describe examples of genetic engineering in medicine and agriculture
Discuss the benefits and risks of genetic engineering

(or genetic modification) is the process of altering the genome of an organism by inserting genes from another organism. Unlike selective breeding, which takes many generations, genetic engineering can transfer specific genes directly and quickly, even between different species.
